summary: Recently, the Ministry of Transportation began a project to reconstruct the Avenue Road bridge over Highway 401. As part of the work, the number of lanes on the bridge overpass has been reduced from three lanes to a single lane in each direction. While this is a much needed project to completely rebuild an aging piece of infrastructure, the resulting lane closures have caused significant traffic delays in the northbound and southbound lanes along Avenue Road, specifically from Bombay Avenue to Wilson Avenue. Traffic is backing up at the Avenue Road and Wilson Intersection all the way onto Bombay Avenue into the Armour Heights neighbourhood. Transportation Services staff are working to reduce delays through signal timings but it would also be beneficial to have paid duty police officers at the Avenue Road and Wilson Avenue intersection during peak hours to manage traffic flow as required.
decided: Motion MM44.30 was not adopted by City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018.
